items.question: Can I switch plans at any time?
items.answer: Yes. You can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. Changes take effect at the start of your next billing cycle.

items.question: Is there a free trial for paid plans?
items.answer: The Dialysis App Pro plan includes a 14-day free trial. AI Clinical Solutions plans include a guided demo and a 30-day pilot period for qualifying practices.

items.question: Are your products HIPAA compliant?
items.answer: Yes. Srimae is built with HIPAA compliance in mind. Enterprise plans include a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) and dedicated compliance support.

items.question: What payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: We accept all major credit cards. Enterprise customers may also pay via ACH bank transfer or invoice.

cta.heading: Not Sure Which Plan Is Right for You?
cta.subheading: Our team is happy to walk you through the options and find the best fit for your practice.
